The strategy also mentions 'The grabber' and SAC, and three cards (Aim High, 1 Grimtaash, I Hope She's Alright) changed in for 'the last tourney'; none of these is in the list, so they are not added.
player_note: The post (31 July 2000) says: 'This deck proved to be rock-solid at the Virginia Grand Slam, helping me get second just 3 differential behind Joe. It beat 2 RalOps by 27 and 30, and Joe Alread's "F*** the Red, I'll Kick Your Ass with Blue" deck.' The Virginia Beach Grand Slam was held on 29 July 2000.
